title: Windows 10 read-only development environment audit

statusDefinitions.PASS: Executed and met the predefined criterion with reproducible evidence.
statusDefinitions.FAIL: Executed and did not meet the predefined criterion.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: Could not complete because a tool, permission, device, driver or external condition is unavailable.

planningThresholds.note: Conservative project planning thresholds only; not vendor minimum requirements.

executionHistory.reason: tee could not open its log because the results directory did not exist; PowerShell did not start.
executionHistory.fix: Created the results directory and reran the unchanged audit script.

fixes: Used the installed vulkaninfo without the unsupported --summary option.
Detected tools on persistent User/Machine PATH as well as process PATH.
Removed nested quotes that broke the Python architecture probe.
executionHistory.note: Run1 evidence is retained with privacy redaction only; statuses and observed command failures are not rewritten.

fixes: Recognized Vulkan apiVersion in both semantic-only and raw-version-with-parentheses formats.
Preserved empty and single-element arrays during recursive redaction.
Redacted the managed runtime root derived from a forward-slash broker path.
Handled empty TPM command output as BLOCKED.
executionHistory.note: Run2 evidence is retained with privacy redaction only; its GPU-002 FAIL was a parser defect, not a hardware failure.

checks.purpose: Collect Windows edition, version, build and architecture without host identifiers.
checks.prerequisites: PowerShell 5.1; CIM and registry read access.
checks.command: Get-ComputerInfo; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion
checks.expected: Native queries complete and return an OS inventory.

checks.purpose: Check the stated Windows 10 22H2 x64 development-host baseline.
checks.prerequisites: WIN-001 inventory.
checks.command: $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $cv = Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion; evaluate build, DisplayVersion and architecture
checks.expected: Windows 10 22H2, build 19045, 64-bit OS.

checks.purpose: Enumerate installed update identifiers without claiming ESU enrollment.
checks.prerequisites: Windows Update WMI/CIM provider access.
checks.command: Get-HotFix | Select-Object HotFixID, Description, InstalledOn
checks.expected: Hotfix query completes and returns all entries visible to the native provider.

observed.providerLimit: Get-HotFix visibility is not a complete servicing or ESU licensing record.

checks.purpose: Check presence of the consumer ESU Licensing Preparation Package KB5126256.
checks.prerequisites: Same provider as WIN-003; package presence alone does not prove enrollment.
checks.command: Get-HotFix -Id KB5126256
checks.expected: KB5126256 is visible in Get-HotFix on a Windows 10 host seeking consumer ESU.

checks.purpose: Determine actual Windows 10 ESU enrollment without reading account or license secrets.
checks.prerequisites: Interactive user inspection; do not infer enrollment from installed hotfixes.
checks.command: Manual check required: Settings > Update & Security > Windows Update; no automated enrollment command executed
checks.expected: User-visible Windows Update page explicitly reports enrollment status.

observed.reason: No privacy-safe native query was established in this audit; KB presence is not enrollment proof.

limitations: Actual ESU enrollment remains UNKNOWN until the user checks Windows Update.
followUp: User: inspect Settings > Update & Security > Windows Update and report the ESU enrollment label.

checks.purpose: Record TPM and Secure Boot facts relevant only to Windows 11 planning.
checks.prerequisites: Native cmdlets and firmware support; no settings are changed.
checks.command: Get-Tpm; Confirm-SecureBootUEFI
checks.expected: Read available TPM/Secure Boot facts; access or firmware errors are captured.

errors: Confirm-SecureBootUEFI: 无法设置正确的权限。访问被拒绝。

checks.purpose: Determine complete Windows 11 upgrade eligibility.
checks.prerequisites: User-approved interactive Microsoft eligibility check; no upgrade is authorized.
checks.command: Not executed: PC Health Check / Windows Update eligibility offer; TPM and Secure Boot inventory only in WIN-006
checks.expected: An official complete eligibility result from PC Health Check or Windows Update.

observed.reason: TPM/Secure Boot fragments cannot establish complete CPU, firmware, compatibility or offer eligibility.

followUp: If Windows 11 migration is desired, run the official PC Health Check interactively; do not upgrade during stage 1.5.1.

checks.purpose: Collect CPU architecture, cores, virtualization and SLAT facts.
checks.prerequisites: CIM read access.
checks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor; Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem
checks.expected: Processor and computer-system inventory is returned.

checks.purpose: Verify actual SSE4.2 instruction-set support required by Godot x86_64.
checks.prerequisites: A preinstalled trusted CPU feature reporting tool.
checks.command: Get-Command coreinfo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if found: coreinfo -f
checks.expected: An actual CPU feature tool reports SSE4.2; model-name inference is not accepted.

observed.reason: Win32_Processor does not expose an SSE4.2 feature flag.

followUp: Use a preapproved CPU feature tool or later Godot startup evidence; do not infer SSE4.2 from the model name.

checks.purpose: Check Android Studio's required firmware virtualization support.
checks.prerequisites: CPU-001; firmware value as exposed by Windows.
checks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled, SecondLevelAddressTranslationExtensions
checks.expected: VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled is true on every processor; SLAT is recorded.

checks.purpose: Compare the real CPU with Android Studio's minimum post-2017 microarchitecture requirement.
checks.prerequisites: CPU-001 exact model plus Intel official product-series evidence; this does not assess the standalone command-line-tools route.
checks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor; compare exact model with Intel official launch specification Q2 2014
checks.expected: Android Studio full-IDE route requires a CPU microarchitecture after 2017.

observed.exactModelEvidence: Intel official 4th Generation Core i7 product series: i7-4710MQ launched Q2 2014
observed.route: Android Studio full IDE only; standalone SDK command-line tools remain unverified

checks.purpose: Measure memory against Godot native editor minimum 4 GiB and recommended 8 GiB.
checks.prerequisites: CIM read access.
checks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory
checks.expected: Installed physical memory is at least 4 GiB; available memory and recommended threshold are recorded.

checks.purpose: Inventory volumes and map project/tool drives to disk and media where Windows exposes it.
checks.prerequisites: Storage cmdlets; some physical-disk properties may require elevated access.
checks.command: Get-Volume; Get-Partition; Get-Disk; Get-PhysicalDisk
checks.expected: At least volume capacity data is returned; mapping errors are retained.

checks.purpose: Apply explicit conservative project planning thresholds for PoC and Android tool storage.
checks.prerequisites: DISK-001 volume inventory; no directories are created.
checks.command: Get-Volume; project drive = workspace drive; test project free >=20 GiB and any fixed volume free >=80 GiB
checks.expected: Project drive has >=20 GiB free and at least one fixed candidate tool drive has >=80 GiB free. These are project thresholds, not official minimums.

checks.purpose: Collect GPU model, driver and current display mode without inferring API support.
checks.prerequisites: CIM read access; current display modes can be null in remote/headless sessions.
checks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController
checks.expected: Video-controller inventory is returned.

controllers.AdapterCompatibility: Shanghai Best Oray Information Technology Co., Ltd.

checks.purpose: Check the Android Studio minimum 1280 x 800 display resolution from current display modes.

checks.command: Get-Command wglinfo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if found: wglinfo

checks.purpose: Check for at least one operational non-virtual adapter; this is not a LAN communication test.

checks.expected: At least one non-virtual adapter is Up; no packet transmission is performed.

checks.purpose: Record the actual PowerShell runtime and process architecture.
checks.prerequisites: The audit script is running.
checks.command: $PSVersionTable; [Environment]::Is64BitProcess
checks.expected: PowerShell version data is available and process architecture is recorded.

checks.purpose: Resolve and execute Git version from the current Windows process PATH.
checks.prerequisites: Existing Git installation; no repository mutation.
checks.command: Get-Command git -All; git --version
checks.expected: Git executable resolves and git --version exits 0.

checks.purpose: Resolve and execute Python version and architecture from the current Windows process PATH.
checks.prerequisites: Existing Python installation; version inspection only.
checks.command: Get-Command python,python3,py -All; python --version; python -c "import sys,platform; print(sys.executable); print(platform.machine()); print(platform.architecture())"
checks.expected: A Python interpreter executes successfully and reports its real executable and architecture.

checks.purpose: Use the required Godot broker doctor to inspect the actual engine binary and version.
checks.prerequisites: Python and the managed broker script; Godot may be absent and must then remain BLOCKED.
checks.command: python3 "<GODOT_BROKER>" doctor (fallback to resolved python only if python3 is unavailable)
checks.expected: Broker executes, reads a real binary, and reports Godot 4.7.2; no direct Godot command is used.

output: "hint": "安装与项目版本匹配的 Godot Editor，并把 Godot.exe 的绝对路径写入 GODOT_BIN",

followUp: Stage 1.5.2 requires separate user approval before installing Godot or changing GODOT_BIN.

checks.command: Get-Command java,javac -All; bounded common JDK/Android Studio JBR paths; java -version; javac -version

output: OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Temurin-21.0.11+10 (build 21.0.11+10-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)

checks.prerequisites: Existing SDK command-line tools and working Java; no package installation.
checks.command: Get-Command sdkmanager -All; bounded Android SDK paths; sdkmanager --version
checks.expected: sdkmanager executes and reports its real version.

checks.purpose: Inventory locally installed Android SDK packages against the unresolved Godot/API 37 candidate matrix.
checks.prerequisites: Existing SDK root; package versions are not inferred from directory names alone when source.properties is available.
checks.command: Inspect bounded SDK roots and package source.properties; sdkmanager --list_installed only when sdkmanager is available
checks.expected: Real local package evidence includes Platform-Tools >=35.0.0, Build-Tools 35.0.1, Platform 35 and API 37 planning inputs; absence is BLOCKED, not a successful export.

output: No executable found on PATH or in bounded common locations.

followUp: Resolve the Godot 35.x baseline versus Android API 37 requirements using the actual generated export build in later stages.

checks.purpose: Audit whitelisted environment variables, sanitized PATH entries, duplicates, invalid paths and command conflicts.
checks.prerequisites: Read process/user/machine environment only; no secret-valued variables are collected.
checks.command: [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable for whitelist; $env:PATH -split ";"; Get-Command <names> -All
checks.expected: Inventory completes; conflicts are reported as observations rather than automatically classified as failures.

observed.note: Multiple resolutions and duplicate PATH entries require review but are not intrinsically failures.

checks.purpose: Check visible Android device and ADB authorization state without connecting or configuring a device.
checks.prerequisites: Preinstalled ADB and an already configured USB-debugging device; neither is required for 1.5.1.
checks.command: adb devices -l only when an existing adb is found; otherwise no device command executed
checks.expected: An attached device reports device state; serial numbers are redacted. Missing ADB/device/authorization is BLOCKED.
followUp: No device setup is requested now; test USB debugging and authorization only when a device and ADB are available.

knownLimitations: Static documentation review is not dynamic tool or engine validation.
Vulkan tool output does not prove Godot renderer compatibility; unmeasured OpenGL remains BLOCKED and both renderers require later Godot tests.
ESU preparation-package presence does not prove ESU enrollment.
A physical network adapter being Up does not prove LAN discovery, ENet communication or Android permissions.
The Godot Android 35.x baseline and Android API 37 requirements are not asserted as a validated combined toolchain.
No Android export, device, SQLite, network or renderer PoC was executed.
